skill_atlas.operation.add.desc: Added directly to the attribute, e.g. +2 max health
skill_atlas.operation.multiply_base.desc: Adds a percentage of the base value, 0.1 means +10%%
skill_atlas.operation.multiply_total.des: Multiplies the final value after other modifiers, 0.1 means ×1.1
skill_atlas.sample.node.healing.tooltip: Increases all healing by a percentage, including natural regeneration, Regeneration and Instant Health.
skill_atlas.sample.node.attack_speed.too: Increases attack speed by a percentage of the held weapon's attack speed.
skill_atlas.sample.node.toughness.toolti: Increases armor toughness, reducing how much heavy hits pierce armor.
skill_atlas.sample.node.experience.toolt: Increases experience dropped by killed mobs by a percentage; fractions round up by chance.
skill_atlas.sample.node.looting.tooltip: Works like the Looting enchantment and stacks with it, affecting mob drop amounts and rare drops; the fractional part gives a chance of one extra level.
skill_atlas.sample.node.haste.tooltip: Each level increases mining speed by 10%.
skill_atlas.sample.node.night_vision.too: Grants constant night vision so you can see in the darkest caves.
skill_atlas.sample.node.fortune.tooltip: Each level acts as one extra level of Fortune for more ore drops.
skill_atlas.help.browse.1: Left-click a skill to view details, Shift + left-click or Ctrl + left-click to learn or upgrade it directly.
skill_atlas.help.browse.2: Drag the canvas to pan, scroll to zoom around the cursor, press Home to fit the view.
skill_atlas.help.browse.3: Switch categories on the left; Ctrl + F searches names, pinyin, aliases and descriptions.
skill_atlas.help.browse.4: Hidden skills stay invisible until their prerequisites are met.
skill_atlas.help.edit.1: With permission, click the edit button in the toolbar to enter edit mode.
skill_atlas.help.edit.2: Right-click empty space and choose "New skill", or double-click empty space to create one.
skill_atlas.help.edit.3: Double-click a skill or press Enter / F2 to open the editor.
skill_atlas.help.edit.4: Drag skills to move them (hold Alt to disable grid snapping); arrow keys move by one grid cell, Shift + arrow keys move finely.
skill_atlas.help.edit.5: Drag on empty space to box-select, Ctrl + click toggles selection, Ctrl + A selects all, Ctrl + D clears the selection; select several skills to batch edit them.
skill_atlas.help.edit.6: Hold Shift and drag from one skill to another to add a prerequisite; right-click a line to hide it or remove the prerequisite.
skill_atlas.help.edit.7: Ctrl + C / X / V to copy, cut and paste, Delete to remove; copied skills are also written to the system clipboard.
skill_atlas.help.keys.1: Enter / F2: edit the selected skill, or batch edit several
skill_atlas.help.keys.2: Double-click a skill: open the editor; double-click empty space: create a skill there
skill_atlas.help.keys.3: Delete / Backspace: delete the selected skills
skill_atlas.help.keys.4: Ctrl + C / Ctrl + X / Ctrl + V: copy, cut, paste (pastes at the mouse)
skill_atlas.help.keys.5: Ctrl + A: select all skills in this category; Ctrl + D: clear the selection
skill_atlas.help.keys.6: Ctrl + click: toggle one skill; Shift or Ctrl + drag on empty space: add to the selection
skill_atlas.help.keys.7: Arrow keys: move the selection by one grid step; Shift + arrows: move by 1 pixel
skill_atlas.help.keys.8: Hold Alt while dragging a skill: don't snap to the grid
skill_atlas.help.keys.9: Shift + drag from one skill to another: add a prerequisite
skill_atlas.help.keys.10: Right-click a skill, a line or empty space: open the edit menu
skill_atlas.help.keys.11: Home: fit view; + / -: zoom; Ctrl + F: search
skill_atlas.help.nodes.1: A skill can have several levels, each with its own cost and rewards; only the rewards of the current level apply.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.2: Attribute rewards support add, multiply base and multiply total operations.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.3: Periodic effects keep granting a status effect at an interval; effect immunity removes and blocks an effect.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.4: Command rewards run once as the player when that level is reached.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.5: Each prerequisite can show or hide its line; hidden skills stay invisible until their prerequisites are met.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.6: A level can also require delivered items, taken from the inventory and offhand when learning; deleting or resetting a skill refunds points but not items.
skill_atlas.help.points.1: Each category spends points from one point pool; every pool is bound to one earning method, its max progress and its progress tooltip.
skill_atlas.help.points.2: Earning methods: killing, mining, crafting, smelting, fishing, advancements, experience levels and play time; kills can be limited to hostile mobs.
skill_atlas.help.points.3: Spent points are refunded when a skill is deleted or reset.
